specification.context: five contiguous Coinbase 15m bars, all first received by decision time
specification.decision_time: actual first receipt; bars ending >15m before receipt abstain; no synthetic past entries
specification.volume_ratio: current base volume / median of previous four base volumes
specification.flow_watch: volume ratio >=2, current close*base volume >=5000 USD, 0 <= 15m return <=0.10, return exceeds simultaneous BTC 15m return
specification.required: API-tradable USD pair as of decision; BTC contemporaneous bar; Robinhood quote <=120s old
specification.missing_liquidity: depth/order imbalance unavailable, never substitute Coinbase volume for Robinhood depth
specification.quote_mark: fresh exact-original-quantity BUY/SELL estimated totals; reported fees included; no actual fills

specification.population: all locally observed mint/pool identities; not the entire market
specification.executable_mark: original exact token quantity; contemporaneous persisted quotes only; fees not imputed
specification.net_returns: not estimated; quote-to-quote marks exclude unrecorded network costs and are not fills
specification.missingness: retain missing, zero-liquidity, insufficient-path and unquoted outcomes; never impute

proposed_policy_status: Complete trade-policy experiments specified in README.md; not implemented or enabled
